name: Zhejiang Great Shengda Packaging Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Great Shengda Packaging Co.,Ltd. develops, produces, and sells paper packaging products. It offers watermark cardboard, offset printed and preprinted colour boxes, creative products, paper trays and paper corners, fine packaging, and boutique packaging products. The company also provides corrugated boxes, cardboard, high-end wine packages, fine cigarette packages, degradable pulp and environmentally friendly tableware. In addition, its products are used in internal and external packaging of beer, beverages, tobacco, liquor, electronics, home appliances, furniture, machinery, express logistics, chemicals, apparel, and other industries.
